title: PhysxTendonAxisAPI
summary: One joint axis of a fixed tendon, applied as PhysxTendonAxisAPI:<tendon> on a revolute or prismatic articulation joint. The parser emits one tendon axis per instance (rotX for revolute, transX for prismatic).
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied instance is published at its resolved value.

columns.name: physxTendon:<inst>:gearing
columns.absent: 1.0. On a revolute joint the gearing is converted from per-degree to per-radian (x 180/pi, saturating at +-FLT_MAX).
columns.notes: USD declares a float array (one entry per jointAxis); the parser reads the single value of a one-element row through the scalar path.

columns.name: physxTendon:<inst>:forceCoefficient
columns.notes: USD declares a float array; read as a scalar like gearing.

interactions.rule: The root API auto-applies this API with the same instance; the parser classifies such an instance as the root and reads gearing and forceCoefficient for it too.
Only revolute and prismatic joints are supported; other joint types log a warning. physxTendon:<inst>:jointAxis is not read.

notes: Instance names are arbitrary (one per tendon), so the compiled cache declares every physxTendon:* column.
A duplicate instance name on one joint logs an error and is skipped.
